messages.subject: Rashid settlement — board approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

We'll put the settlement to the board on 9 April. Can you confirm the final numbers so I can prepare the board paper? I have PILON £74,000, ex-gratia £72,500, fee contribution £1,500 + VAT.

Patricia
